verdict.rationale: Nix and NixOS are inherently self-hosted: the product installs and runs entirely on the user's own machine/infrastructure via a simple installer, with local package builds, a local Nix store, and full system configuration files (configuration.nix) rather than any hosted SaaS dependency; binary caches/remote builds are optional accelerators, not requirements. Missing for 10: no explicit doc framing 'self-hosting' as a named feature or independent hands-on report specifically about self-hosting (vs. general usage reports).
